acceptanceCriteria: Each listed reader refuses or reports ancestry-rewritten using gitancestry.Rewritten, or records why it is exempt.
Tests cover a grafted repository for each guarded reader.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1471 (cemfix-1021n, seal 737ae7506, base ef2a01db5). V1-2259 guarded postmergeconnector and postmergemetrics with gitancestry.Rewritten. Expected: every reader that walks commit ancestry refuses or reports ancestry-rewritten. Actual: appflows, cmd/corvint/runs_baseline.go, breakagemap, dashboard trace, sharedpath, upgradechanges, tracerecordrepo, gitnotes, genesis and root-commit reads are unguarded; dogfoodflow and contextindex were out of the lane's scope.
title: Ancestry readers outside postmerge do not refuse rewritten ancestry (grafts/replace)
